g.text: article views land past the 3-second mark
A meaningful share of our monthly article traffic currently loads past that threshold.
Industry data cited above puts abandonment above 24% past the 3-second load mark.
Scaling a cited benchmark to our real traffic, not a new measurement of Pathfinder itself.
